'''2005 U.S. National Championship Reid Smith LS Watch Your Step (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Reid Smith]] at [[2005 U.S. National Championship]], finishing 1st; the list below is as posted on DeckTech by R. "Voice of Law" Smith (2005-07-06).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=34966 Teh (V)indicator]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050728073920/http://www.decktech.net:80/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=34966 Internet Archive]</ref>
